properties.name: application_modes
hand: written bumps the content generation, closes the group overlay, invalidates and lets a tab that no longer shows give way
properties.comment: The application modes now shown (one bit per mode; mode 0 by default). Changing them shows the tabs and groups that share a bit; a selected tab that no longer shows gives way as a set's tab does. Zero throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: document_minimum_height
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("Ribbon document minimum height must be finite and not negative");
properties.comment: The document area's declared minimum height in logical units (owner decision 34). The height the ribbon's parent offers it holds the ribbon and the document area under it; the plane hides when that area would be shorter than the minimum, and shows again once it is at least the minimum plus hide_hysteresis. Zero (the default) declares none: the plane hides only when no document area would be left. A negative or non-finite height throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: minimized
hand: prepare closes the menus and the group overlay before a change
written moves keyboard focus off the plane, invalidates and publishes minimized_changed
properties.comment: Whether the command plane is hidden, leaving the tab row. A change closes the menus and the group overlay and raises minimized_changed.

properties.name: application_text
hand: written bumps the content generation and invalidates
properties.comment: The File tab's text, with an optional mnemonic. Text that is not valid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: recent_caption
hand: written repaints the application menu overlay
properties.comment: The caption of the application menu's recent pane. Text that is not valid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: backstage
hand: prepare refuses a parented view and closes the open Backstage before a change
written moves the close subscription to the new view
properties.comment: Backstage (phase 6; owner decisions 3, 26): a BackstageView the File tab opens over everything below the tab row, instead of the application menu, or null. Escape, the File tab, another tab or a definitive command closes it and returns to the document. A view that already has a parent throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: focus_region
hand: written registers or unregisters the ribbon as a focus region of its attached window
properties.comment: Whether the ribbon adds itself to its window's F6 regions when it is attached (owner decision 17). On by default.

properties.name: font
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("Ribbon font specification is invalid");
properties.comment: The font of the ribbon's text. A write marks the font as set from code; an invalid specification throws std::invalid_argument.
